description: This Python source file implements the TurnTraceObserver class, which integrates with OpenTelemetry to create tracing spans for each conversation turn within a chatbot or conversational system. It manages conversation and turn spans, hooks into turn start/end events, and provides methods to start and end tracing sessions, allowing hierarchical tracing of conversation flows.

classes.name: TurnTraceObserver
classes.description: A specialized observer for creating and managing OpenTelemetry tracing spans for each turn in a conversation, supporting hierarchical tracing with conversation and turn spans, integrating with a turn tracking system.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the TurnTraceObserver with a turn tracker, optional conversation ID, and additional span attributes. Sets up event handlers for turn start/end.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Method intended to process a data frame but is a no-op in this implementation, relying on turn events instead.

methods.name: start_conversation_tracing(self, conversation_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Begins a new conversation span, optionally using a provided conversation ID or generating one. Sets span attributes and updates context providers.

methods.name: end_conversation_tracing(self)
methods.description: Ends the current conversation span and any active turn span, clearing context and tracking state.

methods.name: _handle_turn_started(self, turn_number: int)
methods.description: Internal handler for turn start events, creating a new turn span with appropriate context and attributes.

methods.name: _handle_turn_ended(self, turn_number: int, duration: float, was_interrupted: bool)
methods.description: Internal handler for turn end events, closing the current turn span and recording duration and interruption status.

methods.name: Optional["SpanContext"] get_current_turn_context(self)
methods.description: Returns the span context of the current turn, suitable for creating child spans.

methods.name: Optional["SpanContext"] get_turn_context(self, turn_number: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the span context for a specific turn number.
